programs.name: Ph.D in Management
programs.eligibility: Master's degree in Management/Commerce/related discipline with minimum 55% aggregate marks; valid UGC-NET/state SET or the university's Research Aptitude Test.
programs.overview: A full-time/part-time doctoral program focused on original research in finance, marketing, HR or operations, guided by experienced faculty mentors.
programs.admission_process: Written test followed by Research Proposal presentation and Interview.

programs.name: Ph.D (Engineering / Science & Technology)
programs.eligibility: M.Tech/M.E or equivalent Master's degree with minimum 55% aggregate marks; valid GATE/UGC-NET preferred.
programs.overview: Doctoral research in engineering and applied science areas offered through ICFAI Tech School.
programs.admission_process: Written test followed by Research Proposal presentation and Interview.

programs.name: Ph.D (Law)
programs.eligibility: Master's degree in Law or a related discipline, as per ICFAI Law School doctoral admission norms.
programs.overview: A doctoral research program in law and legal studies offered through ICFAI Law School.
programs.admission_process: As per ICFAI Law School doctoral admissions process.

programs.name: Ph.D (Education)
programs.eligibility: Master's degree in Education or a related discipline, as per ICFAI Education School doctoral admission norms.
programs.overview: A doctoral research program in education offered through ICFAI Education School.
programs.admission_process: As per ICFAI Education School doctoral admissions process.
